text:
jess: @channel seeing delayed customer responses, SEV2 signal - incident-bot didn't page primary oncall. Anyone else seeing this? :rotating_light:
liam: looking. are we talking missing PD pages or slack only?
jess: paging via PD. we have two customers opened support tickets ~3m apart, but no page hit on oncall. support says customers waited.
maria: checking incident-bot logs now
incident-bot: ERROR delivery_failed pagerduty_integration -> status=403 body="invalid api key" attempts=1
liam: 403 from pagerduty usually auth rotation. when was last creds rotation?
ops-dave: I rotated PD key last night during rotation window — did I forget to update incident integration?
maria: confirm in secrets-store: incident/pagerduty/api_key missing latest key, still on old value.
liam: ok quick mitigation: manual escalate and SMS to primary oncall. @ops-dave can you do manual page?
ops-dave: initiating manual SMS fallback: `./scripts/manual_page --user jess --method sms --reason "PD delivery 403"` -> success
jess: got SMS, thanks. primary acked incident.
maria: pushing hotfix to incident-bot: update PD key from secrets and add retry/backoff + clearer error alerting. deploying now.
incident-bot: Deploy started by maria - build 0.12.4 -> restarting worker pool
liam: after restart can we run synthetic page test?
maria: test -> `curl -X POST https://internal.incident/v1/test-page -d '{"target":"oncall","channel":"pagerduty"}'` -> response 200, PD delivery ok
incident-bot: INFO delivery_success pagerduty_integration -> incident=INC12345 target=primary
jess: confirmed PD page delivered, team re-notified. closing live mitigations.
liam: root cause: secrets rotation process updated PD key but secret sync to incident-bot failed due to a missing IAM permission. Followups: add secret-sync alert, add verify step to rotation runbook, add post-rotation smoke test.
ops-dave: will open postmortem and owner - assigning to maria. ETA preliminary notes in #postmortems.
maria: opening postmortem now, will include timeline and infra fix.
jess: thanks all. FYI customer impact: two customer support tickets, ~8-12 minute delay each. Notified CS to offer apology credit.
liam: nice work. :thumbsup:
